conviction_note: Pre-revenue fuel developer with no consensus bar: the print restates a cash pile (~$6/share at Jun 30 less a ~$5M quarter) above a $5.045 spot and may date the PIE start, against a nuclear tape sold on 5%+ yields and an unknown Q3 ATM draw; findings sum +0.8 and the scaled number is +0.44 (p_up 54 x abs 5.5), both small because the cash discount is already written up (EveryTicker 10-29) and 2026 prints moved +2.1/-4.5/+0.7. The call is at 16:00 ET, after the window's last close, so only the release reaches the trade.
bar: No bar exists: no published consensus for Q3 FY2026 (Fintool says S&P consensus unavailable for Q3 2025-Q1 2026, https://fintool.com/app/research/companies/LTBR/documents/transcripts/q3-2025 ; Benzinga shows only a stale Q3 2025 entry). The company gives no financial guidance (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001084554/000147793226004726/ltbr_ex991.htm). Practical reference: Q2 net loss $5.8M / EPS -$0.18, Q3 2025 net loss $4.1M / -$0.16 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793225007930/ltbr_ex991.htm), cash $237.5M and 37.40M shares at 2026-06-30. Every size is capped small because of this.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest via Equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/ltbr/shortinterest): 4,336,920 shares short at 2026-10-15 settlement, ~11.6% of 37.46M shares outstanding, 5.5 days to cover; 4.11M (3.99 DTC) at 09-30, 4.90M (8.32 DTC) at 09-15. Moderately crowded. Options: chain unusable (ATM spread 86% of mid), no skew; put/call OI 0.16, so the option crowd is call-heavy. Tape: -21% over 20 days, 1.9% above the 52-week low, -81.8% from the high, with no company-specific negative news (sector-wide yield-driven selloff).

findings.finding: The Q3 release will restate a cash balance well above the market cap: cash was $237.5M with 37.40M shares at 2026-06-30 ($6.35/share) and H1 operating burn was $8.3M, so Sep-30 cash should sit near $230M (~$6.1/share) if no ATM was drawn, against a $5.045 spot (~$189M market cap) - a negative enterprise value that the release puts back in front of holders.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cash/financing lines have not driven 2026 reactions: Q2 (cash up to $237.5M) +2.12%, Q1 -4.49%, FY25 +0.65% (baseline). The 2025-11-05 print -22.4% came in the 2025 nuclear unwind, not on cash.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the below-cash discount is public and was written up on 2026-10-29 (EveryTicker). If the market priced the cash as a floor, the stock would not have fallen 21% in 20 days to below cash on sector beta alone; the restated balance is the only company-level number this print can deliver.
findings.independence: EveryTicker analysis 2026-10-29 states market cap $190.1M vs cash ~$237.5M, negative EV (https://everyticker.com/quote/LTBR/analysis/lightbridge-s-metallic-fuel-inflection-trading-below-cash-as-nuclear-validation-nears-nasdaq-ltbr) - a secondary reading of the same 10-Q number, not independent.

findings.finding: The company told holders post-irradiation examination of the first ATR sample batch (discharged May 2026) would begin 'later in 2026', with SHED design/site, LEFF site selection and cost assumptions to come 'over the next several quarters'; the Nov 2 'business update' release is the first scheduled place to date the PIE start or the SHED EPC/site progress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Milestone news has not moved the stock in this tape: the Aug 31 DOE Launch Pad selection and Sep 9 ATR loop access press releases came as the stock slid from $7.55 (Form 4, 08-28) to $6.29 (Form 4, 10-01). Q2 print with the PIE timeline: +2.12%.
findings.why_not_priced: The timeline is public; what is not is whether the release confirms PIE has started (inside the guided 'later in 2026', so mostly expected). A dated start or a SHED site/EPC number would be new; a slip of PIE into 2027 would be a negative. The flat-to-falling reaction to recent milestones says the market does not pay much for them.
findings.independence: Shareholder letter of 2026-09-08 repeats the same list (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793226005448/ltbr_ex991.htm); same company, same message - one finding.

findings.finding: Net loss will widen year on year by design: the Q2 10-Q says the company expects to 'significantly increase' R&D (H1 R&D $7.3M vs $3.3M), and RSA grants approved 2026-08-06 add stock comp, so Q3 net loss likely lands well above Q3 2025's $4.1M (EPS -$0.16), near Q2's $5.8M (-$0.18) or higher, partly offset by ~$1.9M/quarter of interest income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 net loss widened to $5.8M from $3.5M and the stock rose +2.12% (baseline / Q2 release); widening losses have not been punished in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced and inside what the company told holders to expect; there is no consensus to miss. Filed small for completeness.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 comparison from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793225007930/ltbr_ex991.htm; 8-K of 2026-08-07 on the RSA grants (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793226004774/0001477932-26-004774.txt).

findings.finding: Q3 ATM usage is unknown and the program had ~$96.1M of capacity left at 2026-06-30 (of $150M under a $350M shelf); any Q3 issuance at $6-7.5 would be dilution below cash per share. Asked what the money buys: the company says current cash covers SHED construction, operation and decommissioning, and the 10-Q reported no post-quarter sales, so there is no corroborated need - a draw would read as negative, a pause as mildly positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 sold 3.8M shares ($46M gross) and Q1/Q2 prints moved -4.49% / +2.12%; no clean read of the ATM line alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody can see Q3 ATM sales until the release/10-Q; the share count has not been updated since 37.46M at 2026-07-28. If the market expected heavy issuance the discount to cash would arguably be its explanation, but no source says so.
findings.independence: SHED funded from current cash per the 2026-08-31 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793226005448/ltbr_ex992.htm), which argues against a need to draw; short interest 11.6% means a negative surprise meets a crowded short.

findings.finding: Short interest is 4.34M shares (~11.6% of shares outstanding), 5.5 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up from 4.11M at 09-30, on a stock trading below cash near its 52-week low - a positive line in the release meets a short that has to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025 prints with heavier retail/short participation moved +26.7% (2025-08-11) and -22.4% (2025-11-05); 2026 prints small.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public; what is unpriced is only the asymmetry - a dull print leaves it in place, a good one forces covering into a ~0.7M share/day tape.

findings.finding: The whole nuclear group sold off on rates in October with no company news (10-year at 5.26% after the hot September CPI on Oct 14; Oklo and NuScale -15% in a week to Oct 19, Centrus -4% on a no-news day), which is the most plausible cause of LTBR's -21% in 20 days; the sector's direction over Oct 30-Nov 2 will likely dominate a print with no bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print-line history; sector beta, not the print, set the last month's path ($7.55 on 08-28, $6.29 on 10-01, $5.045 on 10-30 per Form 4s and the baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Not a mispricing claim: it is filed so the judges see that the window's move is mostly a rate/sector bet with no sign this search can call. Sized 0 with a wide band.
findings.independence: Oklo -4% on 10-22 after a Truist PT cut (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sinks-4-as-truist-slashes-price-target-39-to-31-ahead-of-q3-earnings); proxy, not company-confirmed.

findings.finding: The board approved 3,000,000 contingent performance RSAs on 2026-08-06 that require stockholder approval of a larger 2020 Plan share reserve (~8% of shares outstanding), plus 1,000,000 service RSAs; the release or 10-Q may disclose the vote plan, an overhang on a stock already below cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history on this line; the 8-K of 2026-08-07 coincided with the post-Q2 drift lower.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed in August, so mostly priced; no proxy has been filed yet (EDGAR search to 10-30 shows none), so any meeting date in the release would be the new part.
findings.independence: 8-K Item 5.02 of 2026-08-07 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1084554/000147793226004774/0001477932-26-004774.txt) - same grants, same fact.

outside_window.finding: The 16:00 ET call on Nov 2 (after the window's last close) carries the Q&A and any detail beyond the release; its reaction lands on Nov 3, outside this window.
Centrus (closest fuel-chain peer) reports after the close on 2026-11-04, call Nov 5; a HALEU/fuel read-through lands after the window.
LEFF feasibility deliverables from the Amentum task order (~$2.4M) are expected in early 2027.

baseline_tension: Cuts mildly against the run-up: the tape is -21% in 20 days on sector rates with no company negative, and the only company-level number the print can deliver (cash per share above spot) leans up; there is no usable skew to agree or disagree with, and call-heavy OI (P/C 0.16) plus 11.6% short interest make it a two-sided positioning book.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (no sourceable bar): all sizes stay capped small; cash finding 0.8 -> 0.5 also because the cash is a reported-quarter item inside what holders already know.
Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; 2026 prints moved +2.1/-4.5/+0.7): milestone finding 0.5 -> 0.4.
Rule 6 (inside what the company guided): widening loss -0.2 -> -0.1.

Rule 7 (crowded short, 11.6% SI, 5.5 DTC): negatives shrunk, ATM -0.3 -> -0.2, PSA overhang -0.2 -> -0.1; positioning +0.4 -> +0.3 since rule 5 treats positioning as the information set rather than a mispricing.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): ATM finding kept negative-leaning only after checking what the money buys (company says SHED is funded from current cash, so a draw has no corroborated use).
Scaled number: abs_move 6.0 -> 5.5 because the call lands after the window close; p_up 54 unchanged. Sector finding left at 0.
